boxes: Design proposal: inline validation focuses the first invalid field; labels associate through for/id; required and error text are announced via aria-required/aria-describedby. Pending submit blocks duplicate sends and announces “Sending”. Failure preserves typed values. Rate limit enables retry only after the server’s retry window; capacity refusal never clears values. Success replaces the form or performs the saved redirect; honeypot-blocked submissions use the same success response.

These are response fixtures, not simulated server acknowledgments. Current published runtime still uses separate result pages; replacing them with these inline states requires the recorded Forms output dependency. Spam, plan limits, validation focus, response handling and assistive technology are NOT RUN.
